confidenceLexicon.low: Low confidence: limited, provisional, single-source, or weakly corroborated evidence.
confidenceLexicon.moderate: Moderate confidence: credible evidence with material limitations or incomplete corroboration.
confidenceLexicon.high: High confidence: multiple independent credible sources with no material unresolved contradiction.

citationRule: Render every claim-bearing statement with inline [claim:<claim-id>] citations.
